note: Copy to projects.local.json (gitignored) for routing entries you do not want to share. Entries here override same-named entries in projects.json. A project root can also carry its own registryFile so its entries travel with the folder.

projects.name: ExampleProject
projects.purpose: One line an agent can use to decide whether this folder is the right stop.
projects.whenPresent: Command or file to start with when the folder exists.
projects.whenMissing: What to tell the user instead when it does not exist here.
